title: SMC-Mixer configuration
description: GENERATED by tools/smcconf/gen.py from config/schema.json. A configuration file (SPEC FR-APP-21): JSON, UTF-8. Names live only here (D-8). tools/smcconf checks more than this schema can say (the Shift layer over the Normal layer's fields).

layerMode.description: FR-SH-05. gesture: at the start of a gesture; immediate: at once

pickup.description: the default fader pickup. global: the global default (global.pickup); jump: every move sends; pickup: sends once it meets the target's value; scale: the output converges on the fader

gestureMs.description: a pause this long ends a gesture

hybridMs.description: hybrid Shift: a shorter press latches

encAccel.description: encoder acceleration: the speed scale in percent (more accelerates sooner)

fine14.description: the fine step of encoders on 14-bit targets. range: the range / 2048, at least 1 (7 on 0-16383); lsb: 1: the finest step a 14-bit target has

save.description: how the mixer saves its configuration (Q-26); the core does not read it. manual: when the editor says Save (CFG_SAVE); auto: by itself, 3 s after the last change and touch

type.description: message type. none: nothing; cc7: CC 7-bit; cc14: CC 14-bit: MSB on number (0-31), LSB on number + 32; pitchbend: Pitch Bend, 14-bit; note: value = velocity; 0 releases the note, in the preset's form (noteOff); program: Program Change; aftertouch: Channel Aftertouch; relative2c: encoders: CC relative, 2's complement (1 / 127); relativeBinOffset: CC relative, offset 64 (65 / 63); relativeSignedBit: CC relative, sign-magnitude (1 / 65); nrpn: NRPN, 14-bit: parameter number = MSB x 128 + LSB (CC 99/98), value on CC 6 and 38; rpn: RPN, 14-bit: parameter number = MSB x 128 + LSB (CC 101/100), value on CC 6 and 38

anyOf.description: the preset's channel: changes with it

number.description: CC, note or parameter number (cc14: 0-31; nrpn, rpn: 0-16383, MSB x 128 + LSB)

mode.description: fader mode (FR-CTL-03). global: the global default (global.pickup); jump: every move sends; pickup: sends once it meets the target's value; scale: the output converges on the fader

lo.description: the value at rest / off; lo > hi inverts

hi.description: the value at the top / on

faderLayer.description: a Shift layer of its own, written in full as the Normal layer is
